info.description: Task-specific small model that extracts entities defined by a JSON schema, returning each match with a confidence score and surrounding context, through the OpenAI-compatible chat completions API; extract always points to the latest version. Output is free; image input is $0.15 per million tokens.

zh.description: 按 JSON Schema 定义的字段抽取实体的专用小模型，每个结果附置信度与上下文，通过兼容 OpenAI 的 Chat Completions 接口调用；extract 始终指向最新版本。输出不收费；图片输入为每百万 tokens 0.15 美元。
